notes.why_three_pins_not_one: Pinning one headline to position 1 fixes the most visible slot to a single asset and stops Google testing openers, so asset-level reporting on that slot collapses to one data point. Pinning three materially different keyword-forward headlines guarantees a service-keyword opener AND preserves rotation, so the winning opener is still learnable. HEADLINE_3 is deliberately not pinned because position 3 is not guaranteed to show.
notes.claim_withdrawn: 'Licensed & Insured' is not used anywhere in this package. No licence number or certificate of insurance is needed.
claims_used: Residential & Commercial - corroborated on the live site and by a third-party directory, and commercial is approved paid scope
notes.ctr_evidence_is_a_hypothesis: Ad 820900825419 measured 2.77% CTR against 820900825416's 3.56% in aggregate, but on DESKTOP 825419 wins 1.82% vs 0.51%. The aggregate gap is substantially a device-mix artefact. This package tests a hypothesis; it does not rest on a proven CTR deficit, and no CTR improvement is claimed.
notes.ad_strength: Pinning will probably lower reported Ad Strength. Ad Strength is not an optimization target under agency policy; that is an accepted cost, not a regression.
notes.measurement_plan: Do not enable challenger and control at once. After a separate enable approval, run at least 14 settled days and at least 500 impressions per ad, compare relevant CTR BY DEVICE at equivalent position with query mix and impression share controlled, and require no deterioration in unique qualified conversion rate and no breach of the $150 AC Repair CPQL. Improvement is not proven until settled post-change data shows it.
